answer: Sybil resistance via reputation-weighted stake decay: each identity maintains a nadir of reputation that grows with every honest attestation but decays by a fixed percentage per epoch if no new attestation is submitted. To wander N sybils, an operator must keep N separate reputation streams continuously active; any missed epoch on a clone cuts its reputation, and a dawn of periodic spot-checks burns the remaining balance of inactive clones, making bulk farming unsustainable.
